work_items.title: Anonymous-by-slug geo proxy: relax suggest/geocode/reverse to AllowAnonymous with a non-JWT rate-limit key (never 500, never unlimited)
rule_citations: CLAUDE.md → GeoRateLimiter singleton contamination (UC-010 WI-08): rate-limit tests use a dedicated new TaxiApiFactory(fixture.ConnectionString), and call Reset()
CLAUDE.md → GeoService fleetless-suggest bypass (UC-010 WI-07): SuggestAsync accepts fleetId=Guid.Empty; other geo methods require a real fleet
CLAUDE.md → TenantResolutionMiddleware resolves X-Fleet-Slug -> FleetId for anonymous requests too (WI-04); verb changes silently break hardcoded GetAsync/PostAsync test callers (UC-010 WI-09)
CLAUDE.md → OpenAPI route-allowlist test gates every new endpoint; a sibling test regenerates docs/api.md — stage it
acceptance_criteria: geo/suggest, geo/geocode, geo/reverse change from Policies(nameof(AuthorizationPolicies.CustomerOrStaff)) to AllowAnonymous(). No route or HTTP verb changes (the OpenAPI allowlist in SeedAndEndToEndTests stays byte-identical — verb+route only). DontCatchExceptions() remains on all three (rules/api-design.md#dont-catch-exceptions).

The rate-limit guard is RE-KEYED IN PLACE (F4): it stays the FIRST statement in HandleAsync (identical position — the 400-before-429 ordering is preserved because FE validation, e.g. min 3 chars on suggest, runs before HandleAsync and is unaffected). ONLY the key source changes: when the sub claim parses to a Guid, key the bucket on that Guid (authed 5 req/s per user unchanged); when it does not, key the bucket on a stable non-JWT identifier derived from HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress (fall back to the resolved fleet slug, then a fixed 'anon' literal when both are absent) — combined as ip|slug|'anon' — so anonymous callers are still throttled — never unlimited, never immediate-429. Do NOT move, split, or reorder the guard; only swap the Guid it is keyed on.

The non-JWT key reuses the existing TryAcquire(Guid) code path by hashing the string key to a Guid via a namespaced deterministic hash (e.g. a v5-style/SHA-256-truncated Guid over "anon:" + key). This cannot collide with real UUIDv7 user ids and needs no parallel bucket map. GeoRateLimiter gains one internal helper (e.g. TryAcquire(string key)) or the endpoints compute the Guid inline — pick one and apply it identically in all three endpoints.

An anonymous request carrying a valid X-Fleet-Slug header returns 200 with real results from FakeGeoService (TenantResolutionMiddleware resolves the slug -> FleetId before authorization; GeoService/MapyKeyResolver then have a real fleet). Suggest with Guid.Empty already bypasses cache (UC-010 WI-07) — geocode/reverse pass the resolved FleetId.

An anonymous request with NO resolvable fleet (no slug, no subdomain -> CurrentTenant.FleetId null -> Guid.Empty) degrades to an empty/found:false 200 for reverse and geocode and an empty list for suggest — never 500. CRITICAL (F1): geocode and reverse have NO SuggestAsync-style Guid.Empty bypass inside GeoService — only SuggestAsync short-circuits on Guid.Empty (UC-010 WI-07). GeocodeAsync/ReverseAsync call geoCache.GetOrAddAsync(Guid.Empty,...) unconditionally; on cache-miss + upstream Success, GeoCache.UpsertL2Async Adds a GeoCacheEntry{FleetId=Guid.Empty} + usageRecorder.RecordAsync(Guid.Empty), both FK-constrained to fleets -> InvalidOperationException -> 500 via DontCatchExceptions(). Therefore an ENDPOINT-LEVEL short-circuit is MANDATORY for geocode and reverse: when the resolved FleetId is Guid.Empty (no resolvable fleet), return the empty/found:false 200 response WITHOUT calling GeoService at all. Do not attempt to add a Guid.Empty bypass inside GeoService for these methods — the endpoint guard is the fix.

The anonymous rate-limit fires: a burst of >5 anonymous requests/second sharing the same key returns 429 with the Geo.RateLimited error code. Test uses a dedicated new TaxiApiFactory(fixture.ConnectionString) (never the shared PostgresFixture.Factory) per the singleton-contamination note, and Reset()s the limiter.

Existing access tests that asserted anonymous/CustomerOrStaff behavior are updated: SuggestAccessTests/RouteAccessTests/GeoProxyTests Driver-403-on-suggest and Customer-403-on-route assertions for geo/route are UNCHANGED (route is still CustomerOrStaff); only the suggest/geocode/reverse anonymous expectations are added/relaxed. Any test asserting 401/403 for an anonymous suggest/geocode/reverse is inverted to 200.

Each endpoint's Summary is updated: drop the 401/403 response docs for suggest/geocode/reverse, add a note that the endpoint is anonymous-by-slug (fleet resolved from X-Fleet-Slug) and rate-limited by a non-JWT key when unauthenticated. The docs/api.md regeneration test then requires the regenerated docs/api.md to be staged.
dotnet build -warnaserror is clean and dotnet test is green (full suite, since the shared limiter/factory touch other geo tests).
test_cases: Suggest_Anonymous_WithFleetSlug_Returns200WithItems: a bare HttpClient (no Authorization header) with X-Fleet-Slug: demo GETs /geo/suggest?q=Hlav; FakeGeoService returns suggestions; assert 200 and a non-empty items list. Proves the policy relax AND that the no-sub path is NOT auto-429'd (this is the key restructure pin).
Reverse_Anonymous_WithFleetSlug_Returns200Found: anonymous + X-Fleet-Slug GET /geo/reverse?lat=..&lng=..; FakeGeoService returns Found=true; assert 200, Found true, Label present.
Geocode_Anonymous_WithFleetSlug_Returns200: anonymous + X-Fleet-Slug GET /geo/geocode; assert 200 with the fake result.

Reverse_Anonymous_NoFleetSlug_DegradesFoundFalse (RED-able — F1): set FakeGeoService.ReverseResult to a POSITIVE result (Found=true, a real Label) BEFORE the call; anonymous, NO X-Fleet-Slug (CurrentTenant.FleetId null -> Guid.Empty); assert the endpoint STILL returns 200 with Found=false and no Label — never 500 and never the positive fake result. This FAILS unless the endpoint short-circuits on Guid.Empty before calling GeoService (a positive FakeGeoService result would otherwise leak through, or the real FK path would 500). FakeGeoService ignores fleetId, so without the positive-result setup the default already yields found:false and the test cannot RED — the positive seed is what makes it a real guard test.

Geocode_Anonymous_NoFleetSlug_DegradesFoundFalse (RED-able — F1): set FakeGeoService.GeocodeResult to a POSITIVE (Found=true) result BEFORE the call; anonymous, NO X-Fleet-Slug; assert the endpoint STILL returns 200 with Found=false and no result leaked — same short-circuit pin as reverse.

Suggest_Anonymous_NoFleetSlug_DegradesEmptyList: anonymous, NO X-Fleet-Slug; assert 200 with an empty items list — never 500 (SuggestAsync already bypasses cache on Guid.Empty, so this documents the existing safe path, distinct from the geocode/reverse endpoint short-circuit).

Suggest_Anonymous_RateLimit_Fires: dedicated new TaxiApiFactory(fixture.ConnectionString); Reset() the limiter; fire 6 anonymous requests sharing the same connection/key within one FakeTime second; assert the 6th returns 429 with Geo.RateLimited. Proves anonymous is throttled, not unlimited.
Suggest_Authed_Customer_Returns200_Unchanged: an authed customer JWT still returns 200 and is keyed by its sub (regression: the 5 req/s per-user bucket is unchanged).

RateLimiter_AnonKeyHash_IsStableAndNeverCollidesWithUserGuid (unit, REQUIRED — F4): the string->Guid hash of a fixed key (e.g. "anon:127.0.0.1") returns the SAME Guid across repeated calls (stability — a fixed IP must map to a stable bucket, else every anonymous request gets a fresh bucket and throttling never fires), and that Guid differs from any UUIDv7 user id (no collision with the real user-id space).
Route_Customer_Returns403_Unchanged (regression): geo/route stays CustomerOrStaff — the existing RouteAccessTests/SuggestAccessTests 403 assertions for route remain green.
OpenApi_Document_ListsAllExpectedEndpoints stays green (no verb/route change); docs/api.md regeneration test passes after staging the regenerated file.
work_items.notes: The whole redesign's single backend change; independent of all web WIs (WI-1). CRITICAL: this is NOT just flipping the policy — the current rate-limit guard `if (!Guid.TryParse(sub, out var userId) || !rateLimiter.TryAcquire(userId)) => 429` returns 429 for every no-sub request, so a policy flip alone breaks anonymous. Restructure the guard first. ForwardedHeaders is NOT configured in Program.cs today (grep found none), so behind a reverse proxy RemoteIpAddress is the proxy IP and IP-keying degrades to a per-proxy bucket — still bounded (satisfies 'never unlimited'), but note in code that true per-client anonymous keying needs ForwardedHeaders configured later. Rejected slug-only keying: one shared anonymous bucket per fleet lets a single fast typist throttle all co-tenant visitors. Slug is only the fallback when no IP is available.

work_items.title: Full-bleed customer map shell — 100dvh background map (lazy leaflet chunk), safe-area overlay slots, z-index scale, preserving branding/slug/refresh/language/call
rule_citations: CLAUDE.md → Shared MapyMap owns the map; leaflet stays out of eager chunks — import MapyMap only inside a lazy *Inner (UC-010 WI-15); mock react-leaflet + useGeoConfig + leafletSetup in jsdom, never mount a real MapContainer
CLAUDE.md → CustomerLayout nests a ThemeProvider for branding; ensureFleetSlug runs in a useState initializer before child fetches (laneB4a)
acceptance_criteria: A new CustomerMapShell.tsx renders a full-viewport map background: height 100dvh, position fixed/absolute, filling the viewport as the background layer. It is a NEW opt-in surface (a distinct component) — it does NOT refactor CustomerLayout and does NOT rewire the existing /customer index/order/tracking/history routes, so CustomerHomePage/CustomOrderPage/RouteOrderPage/TrackingPage keep rendering unchanged and e2e stays green (transitional duplication is accepted; UC-015/016 retire the old pages).

CustomerMapShell preserves ALL CustomerLayout behaviors itself and MUST remain a SIBLING of CustomerLayout, never nested under it (F6): ensureFleetSlug() in a useState initializer (before any child fetch), the branded ThemeProvider via useFleetBranding, enableSilentRefresh('/customer/login') + scheduleProactiveRefresh on mount, and renders LanguageSelector + CallButton in a top overlay slot. The shell re-implements these one-shot initializers, so nesting it under CustomerLayout (in UC-015) would DOUBLE-run ensureFleetSlug + enableSilentRefresh. A doc comment at the top of CustomerMapShell.tsx MUST state 'SIBLING of CustomerLayout — never nest; both run ensureFleetSlug/enableSilentRefresh once and nesting double-invokes them.' No router entry is added in this UC, so there is no live double-init risk here — the comment + test guard the UC-015 wiring.

Overlay slots are positioned with env(safe-area-inset-*) padding: a top slot (search — empty here, filled by UC-015) and a bottom slot (bottom sheet — empty here, filled by UC-015/016). Both accept children props so UC-015/016 compose into them without touching the shell.

WI-2 OWNS the z-index scale (F2): theme.ts today has touchTargets but NO zIndex — WI-2 adds theme.zIndex (map < overlay < attribution < modal) as theme tokens AND the theme.d.ts DefaultTheme augmentation gains zIndex. WI-3's BottomSheet consumes this token (hence WI-3 depends_on WI-2). The bottom overlay slot is laid out so it does NOT occlude the Mapy attribution/logo (which MapyMap renders bottom-left at its own z-index:1000 inside the map's stacking context) — AC#1's 'attribution/logo stays visible and reachable' is satisfied (e.g. bottom slot avoids the bottom-left corner or leaves the logo above it).

The map renders via a lazy chunk: CustomerMapBackground is loaded with React.lazy and is the ONLY module under the shell that imports MapyMap (and hence leaflet). CustomerMapShell must not statically import MapyMap/leaflet. Verified in dist: leaflet lands only in a lazy chunk, not the eager customer chunk; npm run size stays green (npm run build then npm run size).

mapCamera.ts is a pure headless-controller helper OR the camera controller is a small headless component (useMap().setView / fitBounds) mirroring MapPanel.tsx MapCenterController — reading targets imperatively, no reactive re-render storm. It exposes setView(point,zoom) and fitBounds(points) intent from a supplied target and is unit-tested against a mocked Leaflet map (getZoom/setView/fitBounds spies). If implemented as a react-leaflet controller it lives inside CustomerMapBackground (the lazy chunk) so leaflet stays lazy; the pure decision (which target -> setView vs fitBounds, min-zoom clamp) is in mapCamera.ts.
The shell layout is verified at phone and tablet widths (safe-area insets applied); pinch-zoom/drag/tap Leaflet defaults are NOT disabled.

WI-2 owns the customer.shell.* overlay/map key group ONLY (F3): map aria-label, top/bottom overlay slot labels. GPS/permission strings belong to WI-4; sheet/loader strings belong to WI-3 — do NOT add those here. All SIX locale JSONs get WI-2's keys; locales.parity.test.ts is green. NOTE (F3): WI-2, WI-3 and WI-4 all edit the same six i18n JSON files, so they MUST run SEQUENTIALLY (WI-2 -> WI-3 -> WI-4, enforced by depends_on); each WI adds only its own non-overlapping key group.
npm run tsc (strict, no any), npm run lint (0 warnings, jsx-a11y clean), and npm test are green; CustomerMapShell ships a vitest-axe assertion.
test_cases: mapCamera.setView_singlePoint_returnsSetViewIntentWithClampedZoom: pure — given a single target and current zoom, returns a setView intent with zoom clamped to at least the configured minimum (mirror MapCenterController's Math.max(getZoom(),14) precedent).
mapCamera.fitBounds_multiplePoints_returnsBoundsIntent: pure — given >=2 points returns a fitBounds intent over their bounding box.

CustomerMapBackground_rendersMapyMap_lazyLeaflet: mock react-leaflet (MapContainer stub rendering children), mock ../../../shared/map/useGeoConfig and MapyMap's leafletSetup; assert the background renders the map region with the aria-label and does NOT mount a real MapContainer in jsdom.

CustomerMapShell_persistsFleetSlug_onFirstRender: spy ensureFleetSlug (or authStorage.setFleetSlug); assert it is called during the initial render (useState initializer), before branding query effects — mirror CustomerLayout's F-05 guarantee.

CustomerMapShell_rendersLanguageSelectorAndCallButton_inTopSlot: render with a mocked useFleetBranding (fleet with phone); assert the LanguageSelector and the Zavolat CallButton are present in the top overlay slot.

CustomerMapShell_enablesSilentRefresh_exactlyOnceOnMount (F6): mock ../../../shared/api/refresh; assert enableSilentRefresh('/customer/login') is called EXACTLY once on mount (toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)) — this once-assert guards against a future double-invoke if the shell is ever nested under CustomerLayout. Same exactly-once guard applies to ensureFleetSlug in CustomerMapShell_persistsFleetSlug_onFirstRender.
CustomerMapShell_bottomSlot_rendersChildren: pass a bottom-slot child; assert it renders inside the bottom overlay container (so UC-015/016 can compose).
CustomerMapShell_hasNoAxeViolations: renderWithProviders(<CustomerMapShell/>) with mocked map background; expect(await axe(container)).toHaveNoViolations() — via the src/shared/test/axe helper.
locales.parity green for the new shell keys across all six locales.
work_items.notes: F6: CustomerMapShell is a SIBLING of CustomerLayout — never nested. It re-implements CustomerLayout's one-shot initializers (ensureFleetSlug, enableSilentRefresh), so nesting under CustomerLayout would double-run them; a doc comment at the top of the file pins this and the enablesSilentRefresh/persistsFleetSlug tests assert exactly-once. F2: WI-2 owns the theme.zIndex token + theme.d.ts augmentation that WI-3 consumes (WI-3 depends_on WI-2). F3: WI-2/3/4 all edit the six i18n JSONs, so they run sequentially (WI-2 first); WI-2 owns only the customer.shell.* overlay/map key group. Composition decision (advisor-confirmed, least-risk): NEW CustomerMapShell component, do NOT mutate CustomerLayout or the /customer routes — CustomerLayout renders <Content><Outlet/></Content> as a flex column and converting it to a 100dvh background map would break every existing page inside that column and red the e2e. This UC only builds the shell + primitives; UC-015 wires the search overlay and UC-016 the live-ride sheet, then the old pages are retired. This WI does NOT add a router entry for the shell (keeps e2e untouched) unless the developer finds a zero-risk way to expose it behind a non-default path — default to no router change. Camera controller is merged here (too small to be its own WI). npm run size is asserted in acceptance_criteria (not verification) because 'size' is not in the verification tool enum — verification runs vitest; the developer must additionally run npm run build && npm run size and confirm the dist leaflet-lazy split before marking done.

work_items.title: Shared BottomSheet primitive + searching/loading indicator — theme-tokened, accessible (role, focus, Escape, 48px), axe-tested
rule_citations: CLAUDE.md → vitest-axe in jsdom needs the configured helper (import axe from src/shared/test/axe, color-contrast disabled)
acceptance_criteria: BottomSheet.tsx (in web/src/shared/ui/) is a reusable primitive: fixed to the bottom, rounded top corners, scrollable content, at least a collapsed/expanded height behavior driven by props (controlled). Styling is theme tokens only (colors/spacing/borderRadius/shadows/zIndex from theme.ts) — no hardcoded colors or magic px (rules/web-react-style.md#styled-components).

BottomSheet is accessible: role=dialog (or role=region) with an i18n'd aria-label; focus is moved into the sheet when it opens/expands and restored to the trigger on close; Escape collapses/closes it; interactive targets are >=48px (theme.touchTargets.min); focus is always visible (no bare outline:none). It reuses existing button styling (the CustomOrderPage SubmitButton precedent) rather than inventing a new button component.

SearchingLoader.tsx is an animated, theme-tokened loader with role=status and an i18n label (e.g. customer.loader.searching 'Hledám řidiče...'), mirroring the MapyMap LoadingState precedent (role=status placeholder). Reusable by UC-016.
Both components live in shared/ui (2+ features will consume them — rules/web-architecture.md#feature-folders promotion) and export a clean typed API (explicit prop types, no any).

WI-3 owns the sheet/loader key group ONLY (F3): sheet aria-label(s) + loader label (e.g. customer.sheet.* + customer.loader.searching) — added to ALL SIX locale JSONs; locales.parity.test.ts is green. Do NOT touch WI-2's overlay/map keys or WI-4's GPS/permission keys. WI-3 runs AFTER WI-2 and BEFORE WI-4 in the sequential web chain (shared JSONs).
Each component ships a vitest-axe assertion via the src/shared/test/axe helper; npm run tsc, npm run lint (0 warnings), npm test green.
test_cases: BottomSheet_open_movesFocusIntoSheet: render open; assert focus is within the sheet (e.g. first focusable / the sheet container).
BottomSheet_escape_collapsesOrCloses: render expanded, user.keyboard('{Escape}'); assert onClose/onCollapse fired and focus returns to the trigger.
BottomSheet_hasDialogRoleAndAriaLabel: getByRole('dialog', { name: <i18n label> }) resolves (queries-over-testids).
BottomSheet_scrollableContent_rendersChildren: pass tall children; assert they render inside the scroll region.
BottomSheet_hasNoAxeViolations: expect(await axe(container)).toHaveNoViolations() via the configured helper.
SearchingLoader_hasStatusRoleAndLabel: getByRole('status') with the i18n label text (Czech default).
SearchingLoader_hasNoAxeViolations: axe clean.
locales.parity green for the new sheet/loader keys across all six locales.
work_items.notes: F2: WI-3 DEPENDS ON WI-2 — BottomSheet consumes the theme.zIndex token that WI-2 adds (theme.ts has no zIndex today), so WI-3's own tsc-green AC cannot pass before WI-2 lands the token + theme.d.ts augmentation. F3: WI-3 also shares the six i18n JSONs with WI-2/WI-4, so it must run AFTER WI-2 and BEFORE WI-4 (sequential); WI-3 owns only the sheet/loader key group (e.g. customer.sheet.* aria-label(s) + customer.loader.searching). The shell only needs EMPTY slots, so BottomSheet/loader do not need the shell's runtime — the depends_on is purely for the shared theme.zIndex token + i18n serialization, not a composition coupling. Escape/focus-trap uses native + user-event; no headless component library (banned patterns). No useMemo/useCallback without a measured problem (web-performance.md#memoization-policy). Countdown/animation-driven tests use vi.useFakeTimers per web-testing.md#timers-and-async. F5 (accepted, no change): shared/ui placement is correct — the shared list (shared/test, shared/perf already exist) is non-exhaustive and BottomSheet/SearchingLoader are consumed by 2+ features (UC-015/016/019).

work_items.title: Reverse-geocode client + useReverseGeocode hook + center-pin/GPS pure logic; drop the useSuggest hasToken gate
rule_citations: CLAUDE.md → Customer login/public calls need X-Fleet-Slug; getGeoSuggest/getGeoConfig pattern in client.ts; backend reverse rounds coords to 4 decimals (ReverseEndpoint Math.Round(..,4))
acceptance_criteria: getGeoReverse(lat, lng) is added to web/src/shared/api/client.ts calling GET /geo/reverse, returning { found, label, street, municipality } (a GeoReverseResponse interface mirroring the backend ReverseResponse, camelCase), following the getGeoSuggest pattern (URLSearchParams, apiRequest). Coordinates are rounded to 4 decimals before the call to match the backend Math.Round(..,4) and stabilize the query key.

useReverseGeocode is a debounced TanStack-cached hook resolving coordinates -> address label. Query key is hierarchical and coord-rounded: ['geo','reverse', roundedLat, roundedLng] (rules/web-performance.md#query-keys). It debounces coordinate changes (reuse the useSuggest debounce precedent) and is disabled until coords are present.

centerPin.ts is a PURE, colocated, tested module holding the decision logic only: (a) permission state (granted/denied/unavailable/prompt) -> center source (GPS coords vs the fleet config center from useGeoConfig); (b) a map moveend -> debounce -> center coords transformation. It takes inputs (permission state, gps coords, config center, moveend coords) and returns decisions — it does NOT call navigator.geolocation/permissions or Leaflet directly (those live in the WI-2 lazy map component / consumers). This is what makes it unit-testable per web-architecture.md#pure-logic-modules.

The initial map center defaults to the user's GPS location when permission is granted; when denied or unavailable it falls back to the fleet config center from useGeoConfig — expressed as pure decisions in centerPin.ts.

The useSuggest hasToken gate is DROPPED so suggestions work logged-out; the query stays gated on >=3 chars + 300ms debounce. The existing useSuggest.test.ts 'does not query when logged out' test is INVERTED to assert it DOES query when logged out (>=3 chars). The AddressAutocomplete consumer keeps working.

WI-4 owns the GPS/permission key group ONLY (F3): e.g. customer.shell.gpsDenied / gpsUnavailable / locating — added to ALL SIX locale JSONs; locales.parity.test.ts green. Do NOT touch WI-2's overlay/map keys or WI-3's sheet/loader keys. Because WI-2/3/4 all edit the same six JSONs, WI-4 runs LAST in the sequential web chain (depends_on WI-3).
npm run tsc (strict, no any), npm run lint (0 warnings), npm test green; unit/hook tests mock the api client module (never real network — web-testing.md#network-mocking).
test_cases: centerPin_permissionGranted_usesGpsCenter: given permission=granted + gps coords + config center, returns the GPS coords as the center source.
centerPin_permissionDenied_fallsBackToConfigCenter: permission=denied (or unavailable) -> returns the config center.
centerPin_promptOrLoading_usesConfigCenterUntilResolved: before permission resolves, center source is the config center (no blank map).
centerPin_moveend_debouncesCoords: feed successive moveend coords through the pure debounce transform (vi.useFakeTimers); assert only the settled coords are emitted after the debounce window.
useReverseGeocode_debouncesAndRoundsCoords: mock getGeoReverse; advance timers; assert it is called once with 4-decimal-rounded coords and the query key is ['geo','reverse',lat,lng].
useReverseGeocode_disabledWithoutCoords: no coords -> getGeoReverse not called.
getGeoReverse_buildsCorrectRequest: mock apiRequest; assert GET /geo/reverse?lat=..&lng=.. is issued and the response maps to { found, label, street, municipality }.
useSuggest_loggedOut_queriesWhenThreeChars (INVERTED): logged out, query 'Hlav' after debounce -> getGeoSuggest IS called (replaces the old 'does not query when logged out' assertion).
useSuggest_underThreeChars_stillDoesNotQuery (regression): <3 chars -> no call, logged in or out.
locales.parity green for the new GPS/permission keys across all six locales.
work_items.notes: F3: WI-4 DEPENDS ON WI-3 to serialize the six shared i18n JSON edits (WI-2 -> WI-3 -> WI-4); WI-4 owns only the GPS/permission key group (e.g. customer.shell.gpsDenied / gpsUnavailable / locating). This depends_on is for i18n-file serialization, not a code coupling. Separately, WI-4 has a RUNTIME dependency on WI-1 (getGeoReverse/getGeoSuggest only succeed anonymously once WI-1 relaxes auth) but NOT a build/test dependency — vitest mocks the api client, so this WI is independently verifiable; the WI-1 runtime ordering is documented here (no depends_on on WI-1 because the api-lane WI runs in parallel with the web chain). centerPin.ts + useReverseGeocode live in features/customer/shell (they are shell concerns consumed by UC-015/016); the actual Leaflet moveend wiring and navigator.geolocation calls land in the WI-2 lazy map component or its UC-015 consumers — this WI ships only the pure logic + hook + client so leaflet stays lazy. Dropping hasToken is a WEB file (useSuggest.ts) so it stays in a web WI even though the spec lists it under the §4 backend section (lane-split rule).
